dedupe_keys.name: mapa digital de mexico v6 inegi online geographic and statistical viewer

description: Mapa Digital de México is INEGI's national web viewer for combining its geographic and statistical information on one map. Version 6, read on 2026-09-28, offers themes including social development and infrastructure, tools to measure, analyse, georeference and plan routes, and layers such as land use, economic units, human settlements, the 2022 agricultural census, geological phenomena, census statistics, economic censuses, the cadastre section of government censuses, the 2017 origin-destination household survey of the Mexico City metropolitan area, solar energy, soils, geology, climates, geodesy and hydrogeological zones, over INEGI topographic, hypsographic and orthophoto base maps or OpenStreetMap. Coverage is national. Access is free in the browser; the viewer does not state a licence, and INEGI's terms of free use were not read on the day. Caveats: the viewer is for consultation, so bulk data must be downloaded from INEGI's other services, and layer vintages differ. It supports reference context for hazard exposure studies in Mexico and road routing checks. Related records: data-inegi-censo-2020-ageb-and-urban-block-results and data-inegi-rgna-mexico-gnss-network hold INEGI data that complement the viewer.
